messages.subject: problem including shiny app in rmarkdown file
parts:
Hello everyone,

i'm trying to include a simple shiny app in my rmarkdown file... 
I've tryed both ways explained here: http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/authoring_embedded_shiny.html

I compiled the rmarkdown file using the knit button in Rstudio, and everything works fine, except that it creates the html file in a tmp directory...

The main problem I encountered is the html file execution. When loaded in a browser, it cannot find the embedded shiny app.

Is there a way to avoid this problem, in order to share this html report file to third-party users?

Moreover, why the html file is created in a tmp directory? Is there a way to force knit to write it in the same folder of rmd file?

Thanks,
Inzirio
